Bachelor of Engineering (Electrical Engineering) - Microsystems Option

1st & 2nd Semester

1st SEMESTER

Common to Aerospace, Biomedical, Chemical, Civil, Computer, Electrical, Industrial, and Mechanical Engineering Programs.

REQUIRED:
Introduction to Engineering
* Writing Skills
General Chemistry
Calculus I
Linear Algebra
Physics: Mechanics
LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table A .
* This course is graded in a pass/fail basis.

2nd SEMESTER

Common to all options in Electrical Engineering.

REQUIRED:
Digital Computation and Programming
Principles of Engineering Economics
Electric Circuit Analysis
Calculus II
Physics: Waves and Fields

3rd & 4th Semester

Common to all options in Electrical Engineering.
3rd SEMESTER
REQUIRED:
Software Systems
Digital Systems
Electric Networks
Differential Equations and Vector Calculus
Solid State Physics

NOTE: All required courses in 1st and 2nd semesters are prerequisites to all required courses in 3rd semester.

4th SEMESTER
REQUIRED:
Communication in the Engineering Professions
Engineering Algorithms and Data Structures
Field Theory
Electronic Circuits I
Discrete Mathematics for Engineers

NOTE: Some courses have 3rd semester prerequisites in addition to all 1st and 2nd semester required courses. Please refer to the course description section of this calendar.

5th & 6th Semester

5th SEMESTER

Common to all options in Electrical Engineering.

REQUIRED:
Microprocessor Systems
Electronic Circuits II
Electromagnetics
Signals and Systems I
Probability and Stochastic Processes

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table A .

NOTE: All required courses in 3rd and 4th semesters are prerequisites to all required courses in 5th semester.

7th & 8th Semester

7th SEMESTER
REQUIRED:
Embedded Systems Design
* Engineering Design
CMOS Mixed-Mode Circuits and Systems
Low Power Digital Integrated Circuits

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from the following:
Science Fiction
Technology and the Contemporary Environment
Scientific Technology and Modern Society
Religion, Science and Philosophy
Power, Change and Technology

PROFESSIONAL: One course from Table I .

* ELE 700 has a GPA Weight of .50.
 ELE 700 and ELE 800 must be taken in the same academic year.

8th SEMESTER

REQUIRED:
Law and Ethics in Engineering Practice
Systems-on-Chip Design
* Design Project
Radio-Frequency Circuits and Systems
VLSI Circuits for Data Communications

PROFESSIONAL: One course from Table II .

* ELE 800 has a GPA Weight of 1.50.
 ELE 700 and ELE 800 must be taken in the same academic year.
